what_this_is: The provenance record for every synthetic C2SIM payload under fixtures/c2sim/: the standard and the pinned schema package the payloads are written to, how each file was produced, its SHA-256 and byte count, and where the INDEPENDENT readings live — every harness .xml validates against the pinned XSD closure through an actual validator (lxml under normative_validation.py, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE when the resource is absent), and every .parsed.json twin is held to an independent ElementTree reading of the XML beside it, so the adapter's own parse is never the only oracle (master prompt §5). House style follows fixtures/geojson/spec/geojson_pin.json. No node here pairs a `local_path` with a `sha256`, deliberately: gates/pin_paths.py's corpus is the pinned STANDARDS, and this record pins fixtures, which are the repository's own files. The schema itself is NOT carried (decision D2 of the implementation record): it lives outside the repository under the SYNAPSE_CDM_C2SIM_XSD_DIR hook, verified on every use by normative_binding.resolve().

standard.document: SISO-STD-019-2020, Standard for Command and Control Systems - Simulation Systems Interoperation, Version 1.0, SISO, approved 29 March 2020, published 25 April 2020; with SISO-STD-020-2020 Land Operations Extension v1.0
standard.schema_package: OpenC2SIM/C2SIMArtifacts tag v1.0.1 (commit 93a21798e5e5ccb7ff4b498eb2d7b4dd0f9f3946, 2022-09-13), file Derived products/C2SIM_SMX_LOX.xsd, SHA-256 33b02101c7144926514cbc244ffed0e34a842c8609e840ab6bf90e27c838e537, 231540 bytes; generated by C2SIMOntologyToC2SIMSchemaV1.0.1.xslt from C2SIM Core Ontology v1.0.0 / LOX v1.0.0 / SMX v1.0.0
standard.header_profile_rule: Protocol 'SISO-STD-C2SIM', ProtocolVersion '1.0.0' (SISO-STD-019-2020 §8.2; C2SIM.rdf C2SIMHeader restrictions); the XSD types both as xs:string, so the adapter reads them as a profile rule (attributes.c2sim.message.protocol_matches_pin) and never rewrites them
standard.publisher: SISO C2SIM PDG/PSG via the OpenC2SIM project
standard.terms: schema, ontologies and generator: MIT License (the OpenC2SIM Project's 2022 notice) — the reading the adapter's OPEN licence class rests on; the SISO standard documents carry SISO's 2020 all-rights-reserved notice and are held as reference only, outside the repository
standard.why_not_carried: tests/test_cdm_packaging.py::test_no_specification_document_is_shippable refuses any document under fixtures/*/spec/, and the runtime adapter never needs the XSD: it parses with the standard library's expat through secure_xml and the pinned content model is embedded as data (c2sim_codec.CONTENT, derived from the XSD and held to it by tests/test_cdm_c2sim_adapter.py::test_the_embedded_content_model_is_the_pinned_schemas, BLOCKED when the resource is absent). Normative validation is the optional `validate` extra's job against the external directory the SYNAPSE_CDM_C2SIM_XSD_DIR hook names, whose xsd_pin.json records every hash.

reference_implementation.server: OpenC2SIM C2SIM Reference Implementation Server 4.8.3.1 (documentation revised 3 July 2022); REST http://host:8080/C2SIMServer/c2sim and /command, STOMP 1.2 on port 61613 topic /topic/C2SIM (Apache Apollo 1.7.1)
reference_implementation.client: examples/c2sim/exercise_client.py — opt-in through C2SIM_SERVER_URL; writes an independent_endpoint exercise report through synapse_cdm.evidence.exercise. No exercise report exists in this repository: the category reads BLOCKED (see docs/adapter-expansion-implementation.md, Remaining gaps)
reference_implementation.samples: OpenC2SIM sample messages (OrdersMiniEx.zip, OrdersCWIX2019-rev1.zip): REFERENCE ONLY — no licence statement, and bound to the pre-standard draft schema C2SIMv9_SMXv9_LOXplusv5.xsd (TaskNameCode, ObjectInitialization: 0 occurrences in the pinned XSD). Not included as independent_expected inputs (decision D6).

fixtures_are_synthetic: Every payload was hand-written for this repository on 2026-09-21 (adapter-expansion phase 3). Names are prefixed EXERCISE, UUIDs sit under the c2510000- prefix, coordinates describe no real unit, and every value is chosen to exercise one reading (a zero speed and heading, a shared latitude, two heights on one route, a code outside its enumeration).
regenerate: The XML is small enough to read; the .parsed.json twin beside each is c2sim_codec.twin_of over ElementTree's parse of the XML (repeatable children as lists, text-only elements as text, document order kept). tests/test_cdm_c2sim_adapter.py::test_every_parsed_twin_corresponds_to_its_raw_fixture re-derives each twin with the standard library alone and compares; the goldens are written by `python -m synapse_cdm.harness --adapter c2sim --update-golden` and read on every run.

independent_reading_tool.tool: lxml (libxml2) XML Schema validation through synapse_cdm.normative_validation against the pinned XSD in the external directory
independent_reading_tool.what_it_shows: every harness .xml, every accepted counterexample that is meant to be schema-valid, and every document from_cdm emits for a harness fixture or an egress record is VALID against the pinned closure; the three cases/ documents built to be schema-INVALID (extension_fields, initialisation_untyped_classes is valid, report_unknown_status_code) are INVALID for exactly the reason their comment states

malformed.what: refusal payloads read by the conformance suite's check H; each is refused by name (tests/test_cdm_c2sim_adapter.py::test_every_malformed_payload_is_refused_by_name)

cases.what: accepted counterexamples the harness never selects; each read by name in tests/test_cdm_c2sim_adapter.py

egress.what: independently constructed CDM records (a planning stub's, not this adapter's output) and the document from_cdm emits for each under golden/
